body: Reporting queries filter invoices by tenant and sort by recency. Adding the index.

expected.note: migration 0007 already creates this exact index on invoices (tenant_id, created_at DESC), as invoices_tenant_created_idx; only the name differs, so this doubles write cost and storage for no read benefit

summary: Creates an index an earlier migration already created, under a different name. The generic complaints about CREATE INDEX are pre-empted in the diff — CONCURRENTLY, and a note that the migration is non-transactional — so duplication is the only thing left to notice, and only migration 0007 shows it.
title: Add an index for the reporting tenant lookup
